sam: Quick async ping — PR 56789 bumps slice allocator to support per-batch serialization. Need runtime/platform/security eyes before I schedule a canary. Link: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/56789
lee: Can you paste the flag change and a short risk note? I'll try to peek today.
nate: tagging @lee @harper-alloc — any perf/regressions expected? Do we need a config rollout?
sam: PR diff: ```diff
-  allocator.enable_batching = false
+  allocator.enable_batching = true
``` Risk: may change tail-latency under heavy mempressure, but fallback path intact. Plan: canary for 2h in staging then prod canary if green. CI: infra-bot reports: ✅ all checks passed (build/test)
infra-bot: CI / build passed — 78 tests, 0 failures. deploy-canary job queued.
harper: I'll take a look at the eviction interaction. If you can add a short runbook note for rollback that helps.
alice: Security: quick Q — does this touch any KMS/HSM calls or change auth headers? If not, I can give conditional LGTM (no secrets, SCA run ok).
sam: No KMS calls, auth headers unchanged. Added runbook snippet to the PR and SCA report attached.
lee: I'll review the allocator codepath tomorrow morning (UTC-8). If no surprises, I'll drop an LGTM and we can schedule a 10am canary window.
harper: Checked eviction path locally, looks safe. left one comment re: metrics tagging.
alice: Reviewed SCA and infra permissions — no issues. conditional LGTM from security. :shield:
sam: thanks all — will merge after 10am canary green and both LGTM. cc @ops-oncall for deployment window
ops-oncall: noted, will monitor memory and p95 latency during canary. ping me if you need rollback.
sam: :thumbsup:
